source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether a situation is best described as a population, community, or ecosystem by comparing how many kinds of organisms and non-living components are included.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: population is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: A group of same-kind fish in a pond is a population, not the whole ecosystem.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The cause and effect in this law run in the opposite direction.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when A group of same-kind fish in a pond is a population, not the whole ecosystem is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: A population contains one kind of organism, a community is larger than a population, and an ecosystem includes interacting biotic and abiotic components. Adding more kinds of living organisms moves from population toward community, and including non-living components and their interactions moves toward ecosystem. The learner correctly applies this rule: A population contains one kind of organism, a community is larger than a population, and an ecosystem includes interacting biotic and abiotic components. Population, community, and ecosystem are interchangeable names for any group of living things.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Ecosystems and habitats. The student must decide: Decide whether a situation is best described as a population, community, or ecosystem by comparing how many kinds of organisms and non-living components are included. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
